### “Let Him Do What Seems Good to Him”
Author: John Starke
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/let-him-do-what-seems-good-to-him/
Passage: 1 Samuel 3:18
Points:
- Eli values the honor of God's name above preserving his own reputation and lineage.
- Eli acknowledges God's sovereign goodness, trusting that whatever God does is right.
- Eli humbly submits to divine authority as a finite creature before his Creator.
- Believers often stumble by craving self-glory and demanding explanations when trials occur.
- Christians are called to meet painful situations with reverent trust and wholehearted submission.

### The Lord Was with Him
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/the-lord-was-with-him.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 3:19
Points:
- God remained with Samuel and confirmed his words because Samuel was consistently available to serve.
- Genuine discipleship requires being ready to answer the Lord's call at any hour.
- God values availability over ability, working His strength through ordinary and humble people.
- Believers make themselves available by staying alert to daily ministry opportunities around them.
